simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַלָּה (H427) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אַלָּה (ʼallâh) means oak. First listed occurrence: Josh 24 26.

definitions.full: H427. allah אַלָּה noun feminine oak (compare אַלּוֺן , but ᵐ5 here τερέμινθος ) only Josh 24:26 the oak which is in the sanctuary of ׳י ; read however perhaps אֵלָה , terebinth (see I. אֵלָה ).
